title: Bound on the mean absolute polynomial value
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, let $p$ be a real coefficient family indexed by subsets of $[n]$, and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. Suppose $p(S)=0$ whenever $|S|>k$, and $f(x)$ is the threshold sign of $\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}p(S)\chi_S(x)$, with sign $1$ at nonnegative values and $-1$ at negative values. Then, for uniform expectation on the cube, $\bigl(\mathbb E|\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}p(S)\chi_S(x)|\bigr)^2\le\bigl(\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}p(S)^2\bigr)\bigl(\sum_{|S|\le k}\widehat f(S)^2\bigr)$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a real coefficient family indexed by subsets of $[n]$
$f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ is the threshold sign of the polynomial defined by $p$
replaced:
Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, define $\chi_S(x)=(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}x_i}$ on $\{0,1\}^n$ for $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $p(x)=\sum_Sa_S\chi_S(x)$ have real coefficients with $a_S=0$ whenever $|S|>k$.
Suppose $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfies $f(x)=\operatorname{sgn}(p(x))$, where $\operatorname{sgn}(t)=1$ for $t\ge0$ and $-1$ for $t<0$, and put $\widehat f(S)=\mathbb E_x[f(x)\chi_S(x)]$ using uniform expectation.
Then
\[
 \bigl(\mathbb E_x|p(x)|\bigr)^2
 \le\left(\sum_Sa_S^2\right)\left(\sum_{|S|\le k}\widehat f(S)^2\right).
\]
